setup_transform_mixin: create a subclass of TransformMixin and call transform_setup with an args namespace to configure train and dev transforms
configure_mask_factory: use mask_factory to create a RandomMask or EquiSpacedMask given a mask type name, low frequencies, and accelerations
load_transform_class: call transforms.load with a dotted module name to dynamically import and return a transform class from fastmri.transforms
apply_orientation_augmentation: wrap a train transform with Orientation to randomly rotate kspace data 90 degrees during training
review_transform_setup: review the TransformMixin.transform_setup method to understand how train and dev masks and transforms are initialized
